pocket_edge_indices = []
for i, edge in enumerate(body.edges):
    bb = edge.boundingBox
    z_lo = bb.minPoint.z
    z_hi = bb.maxPoint.z
    # Vertical edge: x and y don't change, z changes from pocket floor to top
    dx = abs(bb.maxPoint.x - bb.minPoint.x)
    dy = abs(bb.maxPoint.y - bb.minPoint.y)
    dz = abs(z_hi - z_lo)

    if abs(z_lo - 1.3) < 0.05 and abs(z_hi - 2.5) < 0.05 and dx < 0.05 and dy < 0.05:
        pocket_edge_indices.append(i)
